name: meridian
description: MERIDIAN CORE 4.2.1 (Cornerstone Financial Systems), the live legacy credit-union console at web-sample.interface-hiring.com. Values measured in evidence/a11y_diagnostic_meridian/, not guessed.

maintenance_interstitial.notes: The dismiss control is Continue -- a link that navigates to the main menu and abandons the flow's position. Clicking it would 'recover' by walking away from the step being retried, so the step's own URL is re-requested instead.

chrome_literals.description: The status bar prints a truncated session id on every page, including every error page. It is generated per sign-on, so it cannot be enumerated as a literal when this profile is written -- which is exactly what the pattern mechanism is for.

The status bar prints the signed-on operator id beside the clock. register_secrets covers the literal once credentials are resolved; this covers the rendering before that and on pages served after the session ended.

patterns.description: MERIDIAN renders short-form phone numbers (555-0142) that the default 3-3-4 phone rule does not match.
